td.soft_reference_note: Mobility-survey curves guide direction/ranking. Do not require exact reproduction; accept only material aggregate improvement with bounded component trade-offs.

finecdf_td.methodological_note: Mobility-survey CDFs are soft calibration references, not deterministic equality constraints. Native IPF tolerance is unchanged. Full downstream realization must materially improve aggregate selected TD fit while component/network guards stay within bounded trade-offs; otherwise restore the accepted parent and declare a bounded TD plateau.

long_authority.methodological_note: The 12B frozen vector is an aggregate NATIVE_CL 100-200 km guard. It must not be copied to all five LONG components. Component b/c calibration is enabled only after an approved 11E per-component target authority is attached.
